more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured drinks, fats and oils essentially free from water  (excluding anhydrous milk fat), canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, jam jellies and marmalades and similar products. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.overview: Dimethyl polysiloxane is classified in food technology as an anti-caking agent. Its technological role is to keep powders free-flowing.
